purpose: Collect reproducible per-creator, per-format cash and work-time costs without publishing unsupported typical prices or hours.

cash_categories.description: Camera, microphone, computing and production equipment acquired for content work
cash_categories.allocation: Record outlay date and optional documented period allocation separately

cash_categories.description: Existing equipment consumed or depreciated in production
cash_categories.allocation: Mark assumed allocation method; not an additional new cash outlay

cash_categories.description: Editing, animation, music, transcription, design and publishing software charges
cash_categories.allocation: Allocate actual invoices by agreed project period and workload

cash_categories.description: Hosting, transfer, online services, internet usage and storage attributable to work
cash_categories.allocation: Record incremental cost separately from already-paid household access

cash_categories.description: External footage, images, sound effects, music and content licenses
cash_categories.allocation: Do not double count Creator Music revenue-share adjustments as invoice expenses

cash_categories.description: Cash invoices paid to freelance editing, script, animation, audio or thumbnail contractors
cash_categories.allocation: Worker payments as cash costs, not duplicated as personal creator hours

cash_categories.description: Props, sets, materials, travel, locations and physical consumables
cash_categories.allocation: Keep business/personal portions and refunds distinct

cash_categories.description: Paid promotion, creative tests and campaigns
cash_categories.allocation: Track promotion receipts and results as separate channels; paid views may not count toward YPP thresholds

cash_categories.description: Merchandise fulfillment, refunds, payment charges and associated product services
cash_categories.allocation: Do not deduct once from net commerce receipts and again as operating expenses

cash_categories.description: Business administration, bookkeeping and jurisdiction-specific compliance outlays
cash_categories.allocation: Document locality and actual paid date; never fabricate tax rate

labor_categories.description: Market research, topic selection, source review and concept testing
Scripts, captions, diagrams, plans and storyboards
Illustration, compositing, models, motion and animation
Recording, narration, audio work, permissions and sourcing
Editing, subtitles, transcription, translation and accessible alternatives
Title, thumbnail, description, tags, upload and publishing checks
Publicity, collaborations, audience growth and measured promotion
Moderation, comments, live community operations and support
Bookkeeping, analytics review, policy/claim appeals and revisions

content_observation_schema.privacy: No credentials, unpublished invoices, government IDs or private source data in public Mercata unless specifically authorized, adequately redacted, and legally publishable

accounting_rules: Existing owned equipment is not automatically zero economic cost, nor a new cash purchase.
Only allocate actual paid subscription/tool charges to the relevant window once.
Rights-holder reductions already reflected in reported net receipts are not another cash expense.
Claims under dispute are withheld or uncertain receipts, not automatic final costs.
Employee or contractor cash invoices are cash outlays; personal creator time remains separately recorded in hours.
If an external sponsor or product payout is already net of fulfillment/processor fees, do not deduct them again.
Do not turn unpaid creator hours into a cash expense in a cash-profit calculation.
Valuing time for an economic-profit measure requires an explicitly labeled counterfactual rate; the rate has no default.
Zero earners, never-published attempts, unsuccessful drafts, and channels failing to qualify must stay in the defined entrant cohort.

design_experiments.comparison: Shorts and long-form production on matched channels and content complexity
design_experiments.estimand: Distribution of cash outlays and creator hours per completed or abandoned project

design_experiments.comparison: Animation and live-action video for matched creator resources and topic scope
design_experiments.estimand: Distribution of work-hour components and finished-output unit costs

design_experiments.comparison: First twelve months of channel operation versus matched established channels
design_experiments.estimand: Startup cash requirements, nonmonetizing share and first-payment survival

limits: No representative production or labor-hour cost samples are recorded.
Do not label illustrative model breakdowns as median production expenses.
Format categories overlap; denominators for cost per output must be defined.
No particular software purchase or paid advertising is prescribed.
Individual creator data requires permission and sanitized publication safeguards.
